ctx.x: Lawrence worked there with -- Lawrence was the a trombone player, I was the saxophone player and Lawrence's brother was the piano player. Alton Red (PHONETIC), drum, Harold Erroll Scott (PHONETIC) was the trumpet player and the leader of the band was a fellow by the name of Atwell Rose (PHONETIC)
and he was a very, very fine violin player, just a great violin player. So, that was the first regular job that I worked with, with Lawrence Brown, when I was 16 years old.

items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: Alton Redd (PHONETIC) was the drummer... Johnny Miller (PHONETIC) was the bass player that went with the King Cole Trio... We were -- all the guys in the band sang.

ctx.x: (Inaudible). I remember that; that was in the '40s.

Yeah. And my brother played trumpet, Ernie Royal. Had another guy called Red Mack (PHONETIC). He was a very good trumpet player. And let's see, Alton Redd (PHONETIC) was the drummer and Bernard Banks (PHONETIC) was -- Ulysses Banks was the other saxophone player. And Johnny Miller (PHONETIC) was the bass player that went with the King Cole Trio and that's about it. Cee Pee C.P.
